over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

## The next step in meat innovation is hybrid

Combining Meatless^{®} ingredients with meat can improve taste and texture, reduce costs and add
nutritional value.

Discover how BENEO’s Sweets Box brings confectionery innovation to life. Featuring concepts for hard

and functional fibres.

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

[Meatless hybrid]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**NOURISH**

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Strategic sourcing

We are the strategic supply chain partner and ingredient logistics expert for industry leading
producers in the Northeastern and Mid Atlantic United States.

Our short rail ownership allows access to national railways, where we bring in the world’s best
ingredients. Through our 13 rail spurs, with over 75M pounds of inventory capacity, our facilities
can process, package and redistribute your ingredients. Strategically located to serve the
Northeastern and Mid Atlantic markets—with proximity to major interstates—we leverage in transit
heat, covered transfers and other solutions to solve bulk liquid logistics and distribution
challenges.

# Strategic sourcing

We are the strategic supply chain partner and ingredient logistics expert for industry leading
producers in the Northeastern and Mid Atlantic United States.

Our short rail ownership allows access to national railways, where we bring in the world’s best
ingredients. Through our 13 rail spurs, with over 75M pounds of inventory capacity, our facilities
can process, package and redistribute your ingredients. Strategically located to serve the
Northeastern and Mid Atlantic markets—with proximity to major interstates—we leverage in transit
heat, covered transfers and other solutions to solve bulk liquid logistics and distribution
challenges.

Question and Answer

[ FAQ ][89]

What is Albendazole?

Albendazole is an anti-parasitic active ingredient widely used as veterinary medicine to treat pets
and livestock against internal parasites. Veterinary doctors prefer to treat internal parasitical
problems caused by roundworms, pinworms, tapeworms, and liver flukes with Albendazole. But it is
ineffective against external parasites. It is administered orally in the form of tablets, pills, or
oral suspensions. However, it is to be noted that Albendazole is not used against agricultural and
household pests. Albendazole was developed in 1975. It is on the World Health Organization's List of
Essential Medicines for animals.

What animal diseases can abendazole be used for?

Albendazole is anthelmintic for veterinary use in cattle, sheep, goats, swine, camels, dogs, cats,
elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Can albendazole be used to treat human diseases?

Albendazole is a medical drug administered as an effective treatment for infections caused by
flatworms, tapeworms, hookworms, etc. in humans. Albendazole is effective in treating many diseases.
It is FDA-approved for treating hydatid disease caused by dog tapeworm larvae and neurocysticercosis
caused by pork tapeworm larvae.

What are the benefits of albendazole for human health?

Albendazole is an anthelmintic or anti-worm medication. It is administered to prevent newly hatched
insect larvae (worms) from growing or multiplying in the human body. Albendazole is used to treat
certain infections caused by worms such as pork tapeworm. Albendazole is effective if taken after
eating sufficient food

Annual production of 100 tons of ivermectin, 10 tons of acetamiprid, 500 tons of albendazole, 50
tons of trimethoprim, 50 tons of trimethoprim phosphate, 50 tons of tetrahydropalmatine
hydrochloride, and other products

T/T in advance or L/C at sight

Generally, regular orders can be delivered within 2 weeks. Large scale orders need to be determined

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening

interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]

  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

# Ending drug shortages with advanced biosynthesis

[Image of a flower]

### Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs. Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely
reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low predictability, resulting in drug shortages that
ultimately impact patient care.

## Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low
predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

[ See Our Pipeline ][24]

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

### A Trusted Pharmaceutical Company manufacturing Bulk Drug API

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.

* #### State Drug licenses

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

  Contact us
[ Contact us ][6]

### Welcome

Xylitol is a natural sweetener which can replace sugar in a variety of consumer products such as
chewing gum and confectionary, where it helps to protect children’s teeth. EcoXyl, a highly
efficient biomanufacturing process, offers a disruptive solution into this large and evolving market

**Investors**
ARCITEKBio is a cleantech business who’s bio-manufacturing platform allows C5 sugar waste/processed
streams to be converted into xylitol: the world’s leading sugar substitute with an estimated $1.4bn
market. In 2019 we successfully won Innovate UK funding and are now moving onto our first private
equity seed round. If you are interested in cleantech, a sustainable low carbon footprint
biotechnology, synthetic biology and chemical engineering techno-economics [please feel free to
contacts us for an initial discussion.][7]
 
**Waste stream producers**
Many waste stream producers have to pay disposal costs or at best obtain modest revenues from
selling the streams as low value by-products. ARCITEKBio offer a high value chemical alternative and
are therefore seeking collaborations leading to joint ventures with waste producers who are keen to
maximise revenues and minimise their environmental footprint. We are actively seeking dialogue with
paper & pulp manufacturers, brewers, distillers and agricultural waste producers. [Please feel free
to contact us for an initial discussion.][8]

 
**Xylitol manufacturers**
We understand the supply chain, legislative and environmental pressures which current xylitol
manufacturers are experiencing from the historical chemical based processes. ARCITEKBio has a
biotechnology which is feedstock independent, requires no pre-clean up/detoxification and has
competitive yields, purity and techno-economics. [Please feel free to contact us for an initial
discussion.][9]

 
**Xylitol end-users**
We have strong supply chain network for sustainable production of high quality/grade xylitol.
However we would love to hear from xylitol end-users about their opinions/interest in xylitol and or
our biotechnological xylitol platform.  

#### Creating sweeteners from agricultural waste

A new biotech process for producing Xylitol from waste feedstocks. Like wood and straw.
[More][10]

### Uses of Xylitol

One of xylitol’s major advantages is that is has no after-taste and this is driving manufacturers to
use it in more food and bakery products as well as in the pharma industry. 
[Learn more][11]

[[Petal Press Image 1]][354]

Born on June 26, 1993, [Ariana Grande][355] began her career at 15 in the 2008 Broadway musical
[13][356]. In 2010, she gained popularity for playing [Cat Valentine][357] in the Nickelodeon hit TV
show [Victorious][358] and its spin-off [Sam & Cat][359]. After signing with [Republic Records][360]
in 2011, Grande released her debut album [Yours Truly][361], which spawned the top 10 hit "[The
Way][362]" featuring American rapper [Mac Miller][363]. It was followed by [My Everything][364]
(2014), which features Grande's first global hits; the sultry [Dangerous Woman][365] (2016); the
Grammy-winning [Sweetener][366] (2018); and the critically acclaimed album [Thank U, Next][367]
(2019), which features Grande's most successful chart-topper singles to date: "[Thank U, Next][368]"
and "[7 Rings][369]".

Ariana then released her sixth studio album, [Positions][370], in 2020 before going on hiatus from
music to star in the [Wicked][371] [double feature][372] as [Glinda Upland][373] and returning with
her latest album [Eternal Sunshine][374] in 2024. She has also contributed to the soundtracks for
[Charlie's Angels][375] and the two [Wicked][376] [movies][377]. She is currently performing on the
[The Eternal Sunshine Tour][378] and gearing up for her eighth studio album [Petal][379], which will
be released in July 2026.

Ariana Grande is one of the world's best-selling music artists, selling over 100 million records
globally, and has 153 million [RIAA][380] certified units in the United States. She is the
best-selling female artist who debuted in the 2010s. She is the most-streamed female artist on

Born on June 26, 1993, [Ariana Grande][355] began her career at 15 in the 2008 Broadway musical
[13][356]. In 2010, she gained popularity for playing [Cat Valentine][357] in the Nickelodeon hit TV
show [Victorious][358] and its spin-off [Sam & Cat][359]. After signing with [Republic Records][360]
in 2011, Grande released her debut album [Yours Truly][361], which spawned the top 10 hit "[The
Way][362]" featuring American rapper [Mac Miller][363]. It was followed by [My Everything][364]
(2014), which features Grande's first global hits; the sultry [Dangerous Woman][365] (2016); the
Grammy-winning [Sweetener][366] (2018); and the critically acclaimed album [Thank U, Next][367]
(2019), which features Grande's most successful chart-topper singles to date: "[Thank U, Next][368]"
and "[7 Rings][369]".

Ariana then released her sixth studio album, [Positions][370], in 2020 before going on hiatus from
music to star in the [Wicked][371] [double feature][372] as [Glinda Upland][373] and returning with
her latest album [Eternal Sunshine][374] in 2024. She has also contributed to the soundtracks for
[Charlie's Angels][375] and the two [Wicked][376] [movies][377]. She is currently performing on the
[The Eternal Sunshine Tour][378] and gearing up for her eighth studio album [Petal][379], which will
be released in July 2026.

Ariana Grande is one of the world's best-selling music artists, selling over 100 million records

### Complete Coverage^{SM}

Coverage that offers things you’d want and expect for your pet when they’re hurt or sick and covers
exam fees and costs of diagnostics and treatment for accidents, illnesses, hereditary conditions,
and behavioral issues.

Injuries including broken paws and swallowed objects

#### Hereditary Conditions

Inherited conditions such as kidney or heart disease

Issues like destructive scratching or excessive vocalization

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data

clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

to make their calls?

litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

#### Uncompromised Quality

#### About Drugzone

**Your trusted partner in generic distribution across the U.S.**

Drugzone Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a nationally licensed, NABP-accredited generic pharmaceutical
distributor authorized in all 50 states and headquartered in Nanuet, New York.

Founded by a New York–licensed pharmacist, Drugzone combines clinical expertise with business
strategy to ensure patient safety, authenticity, and ethical distribution across the healthcare
system. Backed by more than 80 years of combined leadership experience in distribution, compliance,
and healthcare, our leadership team drives integrity and operational excellence nationwide.

Drugzone Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a nationally licensed, NABP-accredited generic pharmaceutical
distributor authorized in all 50 states and headquartered in New York. Founded by a New
York–licensed pharmacist, Drugzone combines clinical expertise with business strategy to ensure
patient safety, authenticity, and ethical distribution across the healthcare system.

With 8,000+ customer sign-ups, a 20,000 sq. ft. distribution facility, and a dedicated sales team of
over 40 professionals, Drugzone delivers efficiency, scale, and responsive service. As one of the
most reliable pharmaceutical distribution companies in the USA, we connect hospitals, long-term
care(LTC) facilities, specialty clinics, compounding pharmacies, and animal health providers through
a secure and compliant nationwide network.

Backed by FDA registration, DSCSA 2025 compliance, and NABP accreditation, Drugzone maintains the
highest standards of product integrity, quality assurance, and traceability—helping healthcare
providers serve their patients better through dependable generic distribution.

[Read More][18]

## IN COMPLIANCE WITH

**Compliant. Traceable. Trusted.**

Exceeding NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 standards nationwide.

[[NABP accredited drug distributor]][19]
[DSCSA COMPLIANT drug distributor]

## WHY CHOOSE US

At the nexus of trust and tradition, we are not just your generic pharmaceutical distributors, but
your partners in achieving pharmaceutical excellence.


#### Valuable Industry Experience

Your business deserves expert guidance, and our sales representatives bring unmatched industry
expertise of 30+ years to the table. They manage your account while ensuring you receive tailored
advice and support backed by deep knowledge and understanding of the pharmaceutical distribution
industry.


#### 2000+ SKUs

As seasoned generic pharmaceutical distributors, our vast inventory includes over 2,000 SKUs,
allowing us to supply a comprehensive range of pharmaceutical formulations to support your
pharmacy’s operational requirements. From widely used generics to specialized therapies, our
exhaustive portfolio keeps your shelves stocked and compliant.


#### Vast Distribution Network in 50 States

With our extensive nationwide distribution network and license to operate in all 50 states, we
ensure timely and compliant deliveries, reducing wait times and helping you maintain optimal
inventory levels. Our logistical capabilities mean we are always ready to ship directly to your
establishment.


#### Best Pricing in the Industry

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

### Logistics& Warehousing

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

### Provider& Pharmacy Solutions

Tailored support for diverse healthcare partners and specialty distributors to simplify procurement
and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

### Compliance& Quality Assurance

We ensure full adherence to NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 guidelines. Every shipment undergoes stringent
checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Strategic Manufacturer Partnerships

## Trusted Partnerships, Reliable Supply

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

Direct sourcing from trusted and approved manufacturers ensures product integrity and verified
traceability.

[img]

Partnered with 75+ leading generic manufacturers across the U.S. and global markets.

[img]

### Verified Authenticity

Every product undergoes multi-step verification and documentation to confirm authenticity before
distribution.

[img]

## Human & Animal Health

At Drugzone, equal commitment is given to human and animal health, ensuring safe, compliant, and
reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

### Comprehensive Product Range

A broad portfolio of quality-assured generic pharmaceuticals designed to support hospitals, LTC
networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

### Hospital& Specialty Pharmacy Support

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent
treatment availability.

[img]

### Regulatory Compliance

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

[Know more][20]

## Animal Health

Drugzone extends its trusted distribution network to veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal care
providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

### Veterinary Product Lines

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

### Specialty Formulations

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

  From Graduates][12]
  (2025-08)
  Tulkinovich, Muratov Bobir
  Show more
  The number of international branch campuses (IBC) in Uzbekistan has grown rapidly in recent
  decades. The government has actively supported the establishment of these institutions with the
  aim of increasing access, quality, and capacity within the higher education system, as well as
  preparing qualified human resources for the national economy. Although the industry has matured
  and some IBCs have already produced several batches of graduates, the actual benefits and impacts
  of these institutions on the economy and society remains unclear. Therefore, this study explores
  the perspectives of IBC graduates on the economic impacts of international branch campuses in
  Uzbekistan, with a focus on human capital development.

  [Investigating Source Apportionment And Ecological Risk Assessment Of Microplastic Pollution In
  The Surface Waters Of Pinang River And Kerian River Using Spatial Analysis][14]
  (2025-09)
  Mohd Rosli, Muhammad Izzul Fahmi
  Show more
  Microplastic pollution in freshwater ecosystems is an emerging environmental concern due to its
  persistence, widespread distribution, and ecological risks. This study investigates the sources,
  distribution, and ecological risks of microplastics in the surface waters of the Pinang River
  (Balik Pulau) and Kerian River (Nibong Tebal), Malaysia. These two rivers are subjected to varied
  land uses, including agriculture, aquaculture, and urban development. The study integrates
  historical water quality data (2017–2021), in-situ measurements, stereomicroscopy, FTIR polymer
  identification, and ecological risk assessment through the Risk Quotient (RQ) method. To identify
  potential pollution sources, secondary water quality data were analyzed using Principal Component
  Analysis (PCA), revealing that both rivers are predominantly impacted by diffuse sources such as
  agricultural runoff, aquaculture effluents, and domestic discharges.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-air-conditioning-make-you-sick

digestive symptoms

[[Field of white fluffy dandelions, with pollen floating in the breeze]][35]
[Allergies][36]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/summer-allergies

sniffles at bay

## In It for the Long Run

[[Person using fartlek techique while running in a park]][38]
[Exercise & Fitness][39]

##### [What Is Fartlek Training?][40]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/fartlek-run

fitness and keep your routine from getting ... too routine

[[Person looking over a new running shoe in a store]][41]

[[Older people dancing together]][65]

[[A plate of baked cod and vegetables]][77]

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.
