## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.

* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

and industrial sectors — trusted by manufacturers worldwide for our consistency, reliability, and

procurement teams to provide formulation advice, solve application issues, and adapt ingredients to
your process needs.That’s why leading producers in over 20 countries rely on KosNature — not just
for ingredients, but for peace of mind.

## Natural Functional Ingredients

Plant-based actives and standardized botanical compounds developed for brands seeking stability,
traceability and verifiable functional benefits.
Many of these ingredients come from our co2 extraction processing lines, especially those used in
cosmetics, nutraceuticals and specialized wellness formulations.

[Explore Natural Functional Ingredients][132]
[Technical Functional Ingredients]

## Technical Functional Ingredients

Functional systems designed to solve texture, stability and processing issues in food and industrial
manufacturing.
These include modified starches, hydrocolloids, flow improvers and engineered silica structures used
by factories that need predictable performance under real production conditions.

[Explore Technical Functional Ingredients][133]

**KosNature’s Value For Customers**

As a manufacturer of natural functional ingredients, **we go beyond supply — we deliver real
support**. From **rush orders** to **custom packaging and formulation advice**, we tailor our
services to meet your unique production needs.

With deep industry knowledge and hands-on experience, our team provides **responsive technical
support** to help you integrate our ingredients smoothly and efficiently.

We understand the importance of quality, reliability, and timing — and we’re committed to being a
partner you can count on.

KosNature has been specializing in natural functional ingredients since 2002. With two decades of

industrial sectors. Our commitment to quality, consistency, and customer satisfaction allows us to
meet the evolving demands of global clients.

✅ 2. GMP-Compliant Production Line

Our production facilities are built to meet GMP and ISO22000 standards, ensuring full compliance
with international safety and hygiene protocols. We operate with modern equipment and clean-room
conditions, focusing on product integrity, safety, and traceability. Every batch is handled by
trained professionals committed to precision and quality.

✅ 3. Strict Quality Control

Quality begins with our raw materials — carefully selected and tested before processing. Throughout
production, our QC team conducts multi-stage inspections, including in-process checks, finished

microbial testing to ensure consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance.

KosNature ships directly from our factory, reducing lead times and ensuring better control over
quality and logistics. With efficient production planning and strong supply chain management, we
guarantee 10–15 day lead time for most orders. Our export team handles documentation, customs, and
international shipping with speed and accuracy.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

## About Niran Bio Tech

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global supplier network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of acidulants and functional ingredients, supporting
consistent quality, flavor balance, and performance across diverse food and beverage applications,
including beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy, and nutrition products.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Areas of Focus

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115] 
[Milestones][116] 
[Pipeline & Clinical Trials ][117]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

#### Starting with Charles Pfizer inventing an almond-flavored antiparasite medicine in 1849, our

health outcomes.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &

**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# We provide pet health, safety, and behavior resources.
# You provide the love.

[dog and cat snuggling preventive vet homepage]

## Health, safety, and happiness. It’s what every dog and cat deserves.
## It’s why we’re here. We’re glad you found us.

This is your place for information focused on your pet’s health and mental well-being for every
stage of your journey together.

Our team of preventive health and critical care veterinarians, certified trainers, behavior
consultants, and extremely passionate pet lovers are doing all the leg work to provide you with
clear, concise pet care information you can trust.

This is all we focus on: education, advice, and support for you and your pet. Along with our
extensive library of articles, we offer [virtual dog training classes][28] and recommended product
solutions for your pet’s health and behavior needs.

## Sniff around and explore our pet resource library!

[ [cat sitting in the sink after using pet safer cleaning products] ][29]
[

## Cleaning Products That Are Safe for Pets

][30]

Cleaning product ingredients can be toxic to your dog or cat, like bleach, ammonia, and more! Learn
about pet-safe cleaning product alternatives.

[ [close up of foxtail grass seed awns that are harmful to dogs] ][31]
[

## How to Remove Foxtails From Your Dog & Prevent Injury

][32]

Foxtails can injure your dog and cause pain and infections. Learn how to prevent foxtail injuries
and how to remove foxtails from your dog's fur and body.

[ [black and white cat entering a litter box but not peeing] ][33]
[

## Cat Can't Pee? It's An Emergency.

][34]

Find out if your cat has a urethral obstruction. This is a severe and critical medical emergency.
Death can occur without prompt and appropriate treatment.

[ [scented candle that is dangerous for pets] ][35]
[

## Scents That Are Harmful to Pets & Ones That Are Safe

][36]

Commonly used scents can cause breathing difficulties and other illnesses in your pets. Learn about
harmful scents you may be using and safe alternatives.

[ [healthy dogs well-trimmed paw pads] ][37]
[

## How to Properly Care for Your Dog's Paw Pads

][38]

Dogs can suffer from blisters, torn, or burnt paw pads, or mats between their toes. Here are tips to
make sure your dog's paw pads stay clean and healthy!

[ [Recommended pet dental products] ][39]
[

## Vet Approved Dental Products for Pets

][40]

Dental health is important to overall health. Keep your pet's oral health in check with these
recommended products trusted by veterinarians.

[ [cat using an interactive food puzzle] ][41]
[

## Cat Interactive Food Puzzles & Why You Should Use Them

][42]

Cat food puzzles can be filled with treats, kibble, and wet food. Interactive toys have many
benefits, from burning mental energy to combatting boredom.

[ [chocolate lab mix wearing a diaper because of incontinence] ][43]
[

## Incontinence: Is Your Dog Leaking?

][44]

Incontinence can happen to any dog but 5%–20% of spayed dogs deal with urine leakage. The good news
is that there are treatments and ways to help your dog.

[ [cat hissing with their ears positioned back] ][45]
[

## Decoding Feline Fury: Understanding Cat Aggression Toward Humans

][46]

See and hear the signs of feline aggression. Cats express themselves through body postures, facial
expressions, and vocalization. Learn about them here.

[ [the 123 pattern game for dogs] ][47]
[

## Overcome Dog Leash Pulling with the 1-2-3 Pattern Game

][48]

Playing this easy pattern game teaches your dog to heel, prevents leash pulling, helps your dog
ignore distractions, and helps leash reactivity training

[ [tersano iclean product that is pet-safe] ][49]
[

## The Best Pet-Safe Cleaner & Disinfectant

][50]

The iClean mini turns water into a disinfectant. The aqueous ozone technology has been proven to
kill COVID-19, Parvovirus, E. coli, Salmonella, and more. 

[ [what to do if your dog gets stung by a bee] ][51]
[

## What To Do if Your Dog Is Stung

][52]

Did your dog get stung by a bee, wasp, or hornet? Read about at-home treatments, when a trip to the
veterinarian is needed, and bee sting prevention tips.

down with too much, too soon.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren

[Rendering einer bottelpack Anlage bp550]

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

[BFS entdecken][42]
[bottelpack Anlagen entdecken][43]

cdmo

## BFS-Lohnabfüllung und Entwicklung

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

## THE RIGHT PRODUCTS

We deliver materials that meet your exact specifications every time, backed by global sourcing and
deep relationships with major manufacturers. Our expertise in core specialty chemicals ensures
unmatched stock availability.

## THE RIGHT PLACE

Strategic U.S. stock locations and dedicated inventories minimize risk and lead times. Our global
and domestic supply chain adapts to shifting trade for seamless delivery.

## THE RIGHT PRICE

Competitive pricing, creative cost-saving strategies, and a long-term commitment to your success
deliver maximum value.

### Supplying Critical Materials Across North America’s Most Demanding Markets

Silver Fern supports manufacturers across a wide range of specialty and industrial markets, from
plastics, coatings, and adhesives to agriculture, food processing, energy, and advanced
manufacturing. Our strength is understanding how material requirements change by application,
regulation, and supply chain risk, and positioning inventory, sourcing, and technical support
accordingly.

Whether you need a reliable core raw material or a hard-to-source specialty input, we help ensure
continuity, compliance, and confidence across every market we serve.

###### Is a Refill Perfume Business Promising? Here's How Much Capital You Need

Starting a refill perfume business has great potential for high profits, thanks to the strong demand
for fragrances. This demand is particularly strong among urban dwellers who lead busy lives and need
to stay fresh in hot and sunny environments. It's no surprise that the demand for perfumes and
fragrances continues to rise.



According to Statista, revenue in Indonesia’s fragrance market is expected to reach USD 56.02
million in 2024. The market is projected to grow at an annual rate (CAGR 2024-2029) of 4.97%,
resulting in an estimated market volume of USD 71.38 million by 2029.

Contrary to popular belief, starting a refill perfume business doesn’t always require a large
investment. With an estimated capital in the tens of millions of rupiah, you can start your refill
perfume business.



### Initial Inventory Costs

Here’s a breakdown of the initial inventory costs:
* **Perfume Syringes (10 pcs)**: Rp 25,000
* **Permanent Perfume Syringes (2 pcs)**: Rp 20,000
* **Measuring Cups (10, 25, 50, 100 ml)**: Rp 75,000
* **Display Cabinets (3 cabinets for a 3×4 m shop)**: Rp 4,500,000
* **Cashier Table**: Rp 500,000
* **Wall Display Racks (1×2 m, 4 pcs)**: Rp 6,000,000
* **Banners, Signs, Lights, Fit-Out**: Rp 1,000,000

The estimated total cost for these items is **Rp 12,120,000**.



### Initial Raw Material Costs

For the initial raw materials, you can start with approximately 150 bottles of perfume, each
containing 100 ml of perfume oil. Here’s a list of the necessary materials and their estimated
costs:
* **Perfume Oil (150 pcs, 100 ml each)**: ± Rp 13,000,000
* **Aluminum Bottles (150 pcs)**: Rp 1,500,000
* **Prima Absolute Solvent / Ethanol (2 liters)**: Rp 110,000
* **Absolute Cleaner (1 liter)**: Rp 20,000
* **DPG / Solvent (1 liter)**: Rp 57,000

Thinking About Starting a Perfume Oil Business? Here’s How!

Perfume has become a staple for many people. A pleasant fragrance can boost confidence, making
perfume a daily necessity for some. Both nationally and globally, people view perfume as an
essential part of life.

According to a study by Kantar and Stanpa on Spanish citizens, 94.6% of people use perfume
regularly, 61% consider perfume very important, and 54.7% use it daily. This research highlights the
significance of perfume in people's lives. Additionally, Grand View Research reported that the
global perfume market was valued at USD 50.85 billion in 2022 and is expected to grow at a compound
annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.9% from 2023 to 2030.

However, nowadays, you don’t need to shop at stores selling branded perfumes to get a great
fragrance. Instead, you can simply buy the perfume oils.

If you've visited a perfume shop in a mall or a roadside store selling unbranded perfumes in glass
bottles, chances are it's a perfume oil business. Perfume oil is the pure essence or extract of
various fragrances. It remains in its original form, without any added ingredients, including
alcohol. For example, if you want a fruity scent, you would distill the extract from fruits.

Starting a perfume oil business can also be profitable because it’s affordable, the products are
unbranded, the customers are typically from the middle to lower income brackets, the scents are
diverse, and the buying frequency is high, although the profit margins are smaller.

Prepare Business Capital

Promotion

To attract customers, promote your perfume oil business, possibly by offering discounts on the oils.

###### Is a Refill Perfume Business Promising? Here's How Much Capital You Need

Starting a refill perfume business has great potential for high profits, thanks to the strong demand
for fragrances. This demand is particularly strong among urban dwellers who lead busy lives and need
to stay fresh in hot and sunny environments. It's no surprise that the demand for perfumes and
fragrances continues to rise.



According to Statista, revenue in Indonesia’s fragrance market is expected to reach USD 56.02
million in 2024. The market is projected to grow at an annual rate (CAGR 2024-2029) of 4.97%,
resulting in an estimated market volume of USD 71.38 million by 2029.

Contrary to popular belief, starting a refill perfume business doesn’t always require a large
investment. With an estimated capital in the tens of millions of rupiah, you can start your refill
perfume business.



### Initial Inventory Costs

Here’s a breakdown of the initial inventory costs:
* **Perfume Syringes (10 pcs)**: Rp 25,000
* **Permanent Perfume Syringes (2 pcs)**: Rp 20,000
* **Measuring Cups (10, 25, 50, 100 ml)**: Rp 75,000
* **Display Cabinets (3 cabinets for a 3×4 m shop)**: Rp 4,500,000
* **Cashier Table**: Rp 500,000
* **Wall Display Racks (1×2 m, 4 pcs)**: Rp 6,000,000
* **Banners, Signs, Lights, Fit-Out**: Rp 1,000,000

The estimated total cost for these items is **Rp 12,120,000**.



### Initial Raw Material Costs

For the initial raw materials, you can start with approximately 150 bottles of perfume, each
containing 100 ml of perfume oil. Here’s a list of the necessary materials and their estimated
costs:
* **Perfume Oil (150 pcs, 100 ml each)**: ± Rp 13,000,000
* **Aluminum Bottles (150 pcs)**: Rp 1,500,000

* **Glass Spray Bottles (20 ml, 2 dozen)**: Rp 120,000
* **Glass Spray Bottles (30 ml, 2 dozen)**: Rp 120,000

* **Glass Spray Bottles (100 ml, 1 dozen)**: Rp 96,000
* **Waterproof Stickers (150 pcs)**: Rp 600,000

These materials bring the estimated raw material costs to **± Rp 16,313,500**.


In total, your estimated initial investment for inventory and raw materials would be around **Rp
28,433,500**. This amount can set you up to start a promising refill perfume business with a wide
range of products.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by

the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### Quick Contact









### About Virchow

Virchow Group comprises of six independent active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), one
bio-pharmaceutical and two drug intermediate companies. All these companies function
independently with their own management structures.

Incorporated in 1981, the flagship company of the group, Virchow Laboratories Limited is
today the largest producer of Sulfamethoxazole in the world.  In fact, Virchow Group services
more than 80% of the worldwide Sulfamethoxazole requirement. Other group companies are
world leading manufacturers of Cephalosporin’s, Tramadol and various other
APIs and bio-pharmaceutical Finished Dosage Forms (FDF’s). Virchow also undertakes
custom synthesis and manufacture of drug intermediates and bulk chemicals.

### Our Products

[ Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients ][51]

[ Intermediates ][52]

[ Bulk Chemicals ][53]

[ Finished Dosage Forms- Specialities ][54]

[ Finished Dosage Forms - Classicals ][55]

### Our Products

##### Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

Active pharmaceutical ingredients or APIs can be defined as the chemicals used to manufacture
pharmaceutical drugs.

##### Intermediates

Commercial terminology used for Direct Compressible (DC). It comprises a mixture of active
substances and excipients, usually in powder form

##### Finished Dosage Forms - Special

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

##### Bulk Chemicals

A group of chemicals that are made on a very large scale to satisfy global markets, The chemistry
and processes used to create organic commodity chemicals

##### Pipeline APIs

Set of drug candidates that a pharmaceutical company has under discovery or development at any given
point in time.

##### Finished Dosage Forms-Classicals

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

### Our Management

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy
Managing Director (Commercial)

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy is a medical doctor and passed his MBBS from Andhra University in 1968.  After
a few years of medical practice, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited along with Mr. Narayana
Reddy in 1983. 

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy
Managing Director (Technical)

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy is a post graduate in Organic Chemistry from Sri Venkateswara University in
1976.  After having an experience of about 7 years in R&D and production in a couple of bulk drug
units, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited in 1983. 

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala
Director

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala completed his B. Tech in Chemical Engineering from Indian Institute of
Technology, Mumbai and MS in Chemical Engineering from Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa, USA. He
later did his MBA in Finance from Indiana University, Bloomington, USA . 

Mr. Mundla Vishnu
Director

Mr. Maha Vishnu Mundla is a graduate in Chemical Engineering, and has done his Masters in Business
Administration from USA with specialization in finance and marketing. He is looking after Virchow
Group's new business development, marketing and strategy.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
